# @oubble/capsule

> iOS-calibrated capsule (pill) outlines for HTML elements. Adds the native iOS
> continuous-corner curve to any element through `clip-path`, without wrappers,
> SVG or dependencies. ESM, 2.3 kB, SSR-safe.

Use Capsule when a design asks for fully rounded buttons, chips or tags that
should look like iOS. Do not use it for partial radii (cards, inputs): there,
use `border-radius` with `corner-shape: squircle`.

## Install and enable

```sh
npm i @oubble/capsule
```

```js
import '@oubble/capsule' // once, in the app entry. Mounts every [data-capsule] element, now and later.
```

```html
<button data-capsule class="cta">Continue</button>
```

CDN, no build step: `<script src="https://unpkg.com/@oubble/capsule"></script>`

## Rules

- The element's own `background` becomes the capsule fill. Keep styling it
  with normal CSS.
- Change fill on hover or other states with `--capsule-fill`, not `background`:
  `.cta:hover { --capsule-fill: #0a84ff }`. Class changes are picked up
  automatically; `:hover` and inline style changes are not.
- Shadows: `filter: drop-shadow(...)`. Never `box-shadow` (renders a
  rectangle, warning OUB001).
- Outlines: `data-capsule-stroke="2"` plus `--capsule-stroke: <color or gradient>`.
  Never `border` (renders a rectangle, warning OUB002).
- `::before` is reserved on mounted elements (warning OUB003). Put icons in
  children.
- Optional no-JS fallback: `[data-capsule] { border-radius: calc(infinity * 1px) }`.
- Transforms, filters, transitions, focus styles and events work as usual.

## Frameworks

The attribute is the whole API: render `data-capsule` in React, Vue, Svelte,
Solid or Astro and import `@oubble/capsule` once. For explicit lifecycles use the
side-effect-free entry:

```ts
import { mount } from '@oubble/capsule/core'
useLayoutEffect(() => mount(ref.current!), []) // returns its cleanup
```

Web components: call `observe(shadowRoot)` from `@oubble/capsule/core`.

## API

- `@oubble/capsule`: auto entry, re-exports everything below.
- `@oubble/capsule/core`: `mount(el): () => void`, `unmount(el)`,
  `observe(root?, { selector? }): () => void`.
- `@oubble/capsule/geometry` (no DOM): `capsulePath(width, height, x?, y?)` and
  `capsuleRingPath(width, height, thickness)` return SVG path data for
  `clip-path: path()`, `<path d>`, `Path2D` or canvas.

## Constraints

- Strict Content Security Policy is supported (styles go through the CSSOM).
- Browsers without `clip-path: path()` keep the element's own CSS.

## Links

- Source and full documentation: https://github.com/oubble/capsule
- Live lab: https://lab.oubble.com/capsule/
